name: Akikaze Yozora ~Boy Meets UFO~
source:
On an autumn night main character encounters a flying object and meets an alien girl who asks him to remember their common childhood recollections. Having finished playing the piano she says "I am the one who shot that person."

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个秋夜，主人公遇见飞行物体，并邂逅一名外星少女。少女要他回忆两人共同的童年往事。弹完钢琴后，她说：“我是射杀那个人的人。”

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
